answer: No, you should not be taking lisinopril. Your records show Dr. Elena Marsh at Fernhill Family Clinic stopped it on September 22, 2025, because of a dry cough, and started losartan 50 mg once daily in its place. Your later records, from the March 2026 hospital stay and the June 15, 2026 visit, both continue losartan and do not list lisinopril. The app that still shows lisinopril is most likely using an old copy of your medicines from March 2025, before it was stopped. Your allergy list also still shows lisinopril as active, with cough as the reaction. Ask Dr. Marsh or your pharmacy to update both lists so it stops showing as a current medicine. Do not restart lisinopril unless a doctor tells you to. My records do not show whether losartan refills are current, so check that with your pharmacy.
short: Lisinopril was stopped on September 22, 2025 for a dry cough and replaced by losartan 50 mg daily. An old app list still shows lisinopril; please ask Dr. Marsh to update it and to update the allergy list.
